title: Scallion Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful American-style fried rice dish loaded with scallions.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped scallions and cook for 2-3 minutes until softened.
Push the scallion mixture to one side of the pan.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the other side of the pan.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until combined with the scallion mixture.
Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the scallion fried rice to a serving platter and serve immediately.
Optional: garnish with additional chopped scallions and serve with your favorite American-style side dishes.
